issues.description: Tiny extraction still requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, so the advertised CPU demo fails from the current repo.
Default config points to data/stories, but that corpus directory is empty in the provided codebase.
The end-to-end tiny integration test fails immediately with FileNotFoundError.
Validation loads vectors without checking backend, layer count, d_model, or emotion compatibility against the active config.
Preference steering also trusts vector artifacts blindly, allowing wrong-backend artifacts to crash or produce invalid results.
HF preference scoring assumes good/bad tokenize to usable first tokens, which can silently score the wrong token or fail for some tokenizers.
HF model loading lacks revision pinning, device_map/low-memory handling, and clear auth/cache controls for the default large model.
Tiny emotion detection uses substring counts, causing false positives and contaminated validation signals.
Config values are not validated, so empty emotions, zero topics, bad thresholds, or negative token starts fail later with unclear errors.
Steering selection hardcodes four emotions and ignores steering.min_reported_emotions from config.yaml.
Dependencies are only lower-bounded with no lockfile, making results and security posture non-reproducible across installs.
Checked-in demo artifacts reference source story metadata that is not present, masking that the pipeline cannot regenerate them.
